create_BaseTransformer: create a BaseTransformer LightningModule from a pretrained HuggingFace model name or path
run_generic_train: run generic training on a BaseTransformer model with PyTorch Lightning and configurable epochs
configure_optimizers: configure an AdamW optimizer with weight decay grouping and linear warmup schedule
